If the sword misses, the spell lingers on the weapon and the sword binder can attempt to deliver the spell again by activating this ability as a @HLstandard_action. If the sword binder drops or sheaths the weapon with the spell's charge still held, the charge dissipates to no effect." replace="Arcane school~bonus school spell slots"}

::ab[Hand of the Apprentice (Su)]{next icon=zap flavor="Text from the universalist school ability." standard="You cause your melee weapon to fly from your grasp and strike a foe before instantly returning to you. You can make a single attack using a melee weapon at a range of 30 feet. This attack is treated as a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, except that you add your Intelligence modifier on the attack roll instead of your Dexterity modifier (damage still relies on Strength). This ability cannot be used to perform a combat maneuver."}

::ab[Telekinetic Sword (Sp)]{l=10 icon=magic order=awu ability="A sword binder can control his *bound sword* (and only his sword) as per the *sustained force* option of ‹spell/telekinesis›." swift="While the sword is flying in this way, the sword binder can monitor the area around the sword with ‹spell/clairaudience/clairvoyance›." useInc=wizard~5~10 usage="1 time/day + 1 per five wizard levels beyond 1st; 2 rounds per wizard level per day" useF="10~1~5" useUnit=time replace="10th-level bonus feat"}

undead_master.name: Undead Master
description: ## Undead Master
‹SOURCE Horror Adventures/75›
Undead masters have great power over undeath.

::ab[Necromantic Focus]{icon=warning info="An undead master must be of an evil alignment. If he becomes nonevil, he can still use his powers but can't progress any further as a wizard.~~~Most undead masters specialize in the ‹arcaneschool/necromancy› school, and an undead master can't have necromancy as an opposition school." alter="Arcane school~alignment"}

::ab[Necropolitan (Ex)]{icon=boost-down passive="An undead master gains a bonus equal to ‹misc/half› his wizard level (minimum +1) on Diplomacy and Knowledge checks regarding undead creatures. Because of his obsessive focus on the undead, he takes a -2 penalty when attempting such checks regarding living creatures."}

::ab[Corpse Bond (Su)]{icon=info-down head ability="An undead master can forge an *arcane bond* with an object, but that object must be made at least partially of ‹eq-material/bone›. Alternatively, he can animate a *corpse companion,* as per the ‹arc-cleric/undead lord› cleric archetype. He can't gain a familiar." alter="Arcane bond"}

::ab[Corpse Companion (Su)]{icon=power next flavor="Text from the *undead lord* ability." ability="With a ritual requiring 8 hours, an undead lord can animate a single ‹template/skeleton› or ‹template/zombie› whose Hit Dice do not exceed her cleric level. This corpse companion automatically follows her commands and does not need to be controlled by her. She cannot have more than one corpse companion at a time. It does not count against the number of Hit Dice of undead controlled by other methods. She can use this ability to create a variant skeleton such as a bloody or burning skeleton, but its Hit Dice cannot exceed ‹misc/half› her cleric level. She can dismiss her companion as a @HLstandard_action, which destroys it."}

::ab[Command Undead (Su)]{icon=power ability="An undead master gains ‹feat/Command Undead› as a bonus feat, treating his wizard level as his cleric level. If he lacks the ability to ‹ability/channel negative energy› for the purpose of Command Undead, he can expend 3 uses of any 1st-level arcane school ability that normally has a number of uses per day equal to 3 + his Intelligence modifier, rather than a use of *channel energy.*" order=a2 ability2="If he's a necromancer with the *power over undead* ability, he instead gains ‹feat/Improved Channel›." replace="Scribe Scroll"}

::ab[Reanimator (Su)]{icon=learn ability="An undead master adds the following spells to his spellbook at the given wizard levels." s1="Repair undead" s3="Lesser animate dead" s5="Animate dead" s7="Undead anatomy I" s9="Create undead" s11="Undeath to death" s13="Create greater undead" s15="Undead anatomy IV" s17="Cursed earth›" special="He can spontaneously cast any of these spells by sacrificing a prepared spell of the same level or higher. The undead master can cast *lesser animate dead, animate dead, create undead,* and *create greater undead* as if they were 1 level lower than their normal wizard spell level; this does not alter their level for the purpose of item crafting and the like." replace="5th-, 10th-, and 15th-level bonus feats"}
::ab[Lich-Loved (Su)]{l=20 icon=power head ability="An undead master gains the benefits of the ‹sorcbloodline/undead› sorcerer bloodline's *one of us* ability." replace="20th-level bonus feat"}

::ab[One of Us (Ex)]{flavor="Text from the *undead* bloodline." icon=def next passive="Your form begins to rot (the appearance of this decay is up to you) and undead see you as one of them. You gain immunity to cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis, and sleep. You also gain DR 5/-. Unintelligent undead do not notice you unless you attack them. You receive a +4 morale bonus on saving throws made against spells and spell-like abilities cast by undead."}

wind_listener.name: Wind Listener
description: ## Wind Listener
‹SOURCE Advanced Race Guide/158›

The wind listener takes a sylph's natural curiosity to the extreme, enhancing his natural skill at subterfuge and eavesdropping with potent arcane magic. A wind listener has the following class features.
::prereq{r=Sylph}
::cskill{gain=per}
::ab[Arcane School]{icon=down info="A wind listener cannot select divination or illusion as a prohibited school."}

::ab[Spontaneous Divination (Su)]{l=1 icon=magic flavor="A wind listener can reshape stored spell energy into divination spells he did not prepare ahead of time." ability="The wind listener can &quot&lose&quot& any prepared spell that is not a cantrip in order to cast a divination spell of the same spell level or lower. The new spell must be one the wind listener knows and is capable of casting. Spells cast with this ability increase their casting time to a @HLfull-round_action (if the spell's normal casting time is longer than a full-round action, it remains unchanged)." replace="Arcane bond"}

::ab[Abjuration Sense (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost flavor="A wind listener develops a sixth sense for spotting spells designed to guard against his investigations." passive="He gains a bonus on Perception checks equal to 1/2 his level to notice spells of the abjuration school and on ‹skill/Spellcraft› checks to identify abjuration effects, spells, and magic items." replace="5th-level bonus feat"}

::ab[Wispy Form (Ex)]{l=10 icon=def-magic useL=wizard useNC standard="The wind listener can become airy and translucent, gaining DR 10/magic and the effects of ‹spell/greater invisibility›. Like the ‹umr/natural invisibility› universal monster ability, this ability is not subject to ‹spell/invisibility purge›." replace="10th-level bonus feat"}

::ab[Listening to the Wind (Sp)]{l=15 icon=magic flavor="The wind listener can call upon spirits of the air to uncover lost lore about a legendary person, place, or thing." ability="Invoking the spirits takes 10 minutes, during which time the wind listener must be free of distractions and able to concentrate. Once called, the spirits seek out information on the subject of the wind listener's inquiries. This functions as the spell ‹spell/legend lore› (caster level equal to the wind listener's level), except that the wind listener is free to engage in other activities while spirits investigate on his behalf.~~~The time required for the air spirits to return with this information is equal to what the casting time of the spell *legend lore* would have been if the wind listener had cast it." usage="Once per week" special="The wizard can't use this ability if he currently has air spirits searching for information. If the air spirits are currently searching for information, the wind listener can end their task early as a @HLstandard_action, dismissing the magical effect and not returning any information." replace="15th-level bonus feat"}

worldseeker.name: Worldseeker
description: ## Worldseeker
‹SOURCE Planar Adventures/21›

Worldseekers are wizards who travel to all corners of the Great Beyond. While neophytes must content themselves with study and practice, the most powerful worldseekers are movers and shakers throughout the Great Beyond, power players of whom even demigods take note. Worldseekers are rare sights on Golarion, but among those few, more are trained in Kyonin and Nex than any other nation; those in Kyonin explore the potential of using elf gates to travel beyond this realm, while those in Nex emulate some of the dimensional exploits of Nex's legendary founder.

Most worldseekers prefer not to specialize in a school of magic, for having a diverse array of available spells is a boon when exploring the countless wonders of the Great Beyond. Those who do specialize usually do so as ‹arcaneschool/conjurer«s›. Conjuration is a poor choice of oppositional school for a worldseeker.

::ab[Walk the Planes (Sp, Su)]{icon=boost-def flavor="A worldseeker learns every plane's place in the Great Beyond and trains to survive even on the harshest of them." passive="She gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks and is constantly under the effects of ‹spell/endure elements›." replace="Scribe Scroll"}

::ab[Planar Adaptation (Su)]{icon=def-protect l8="A worldseeker is continually protected from planar environments as by ‹spell/planar adaptation›." l15="She can extend that benefit to all allies within 30 feet of her." replace="The school ability normally gained at 6th or 8th level"}

::ab[Planar Associates (Ex)]{icon=info-power-learn-boost info="A worldseeker's travels and dealings across the planes allow her to make connections she can call upon when necessary to gain assistance without needing to resort to ‹spell/planar binding›. A worldseeker must choose a ‹ability/familiar› for her *arcane bond.*" imp5="She gains ‹feat/Improved Familiar› as a bonus feat and must choose an outsider familiar that matches her alignment exactly; she can choose an outsider in this way even if it normally requires a 7th-level spellcaster as its master." imp7="A worldseeker automatically learns ‹spell/lesser planar ally› as a 4th-level wizard spell." imp11="She automatically learns ‹spell/planar ally› as a 6th-level wizard spell." imp15="She automatically learns ‹spell/greater planar ally› as an 8th-level wizard spell." special="She can swap out a prepared spell of an equal spell level to spontaneously cast any of the three bonus spells (one 4th-level spell for *lesser planar ally,* a 6th-level spell for *planar ally,* and a 8th level spell for *greater planar ally*).~~~The first time each day she casts one of these three spells, the worldseeker reduces the gp value of the material component cost by an amount equal to her caster level &times& 100 (to a minimum cost of 0 gp)." alter="Arcane bond" replace="5th-level bonus feat"}

::ab[Planar Redoubt (Sp)]{l=15 icon=magic ability="A worldseeker creates a *planar redoubt,* a personal demiplane to which she can retreat to rest and plan. This functions like ‹spell/lesser create demiplane›, except the demiplane is up to a single 50-foot cube in size and is permanent." replace="15th-level bonus feat"}
